TierExamplesCostLatencyWhat it adds for DCM / FI / syndicate
Free (this dashboard)FRED, Treasury.gov, Yahoo Finance, Cboe delayed quotesFreeRates and credit indices end of day; quotes delayed about 10 to 15 minutesUST curve, ICE BofA index spreads, macro, futures, FX, ETFs, single-name option chains. No single-bond prices, CDX or swaps.
Low-cost APIsPolygon (Massive), Tiingo, Twelve Data, Financial Modeling Prep, Alpha VantagePaid monthly plans; free tiers are rate-limitedReal-time to 15 minutes for equities, ETFs and FXBetter intraday equity, ETF and FX data, fundamentals and news. Little or no OTC credit.

⠿

Methodology

  • Bond prices are modeled. Price = last mark − duration × change in yield since the mark. Yield = UST par yield at the bond's tenor, plus the ICE BofA OAS index named in holdings.csv for corporates. Convexity, roll-down and issuer-specific spread moves are ignored. Re-mark a bond by updating mark_price and mark_date.
  • Carry accrues the coupon, or the yield at the mark date when coupon is blank.
  • Performance holds today's holdings constant over the past year and uses daily total return. Benchmarks use dividend-adjusted ETF prices.
  • Correlations use daily changes for yields, spreads, VIX and MOVE, and daily % returns otherwise.
  • Market health grades 13 indicators across six domains against thresholds in config.R.
  • Live vs delayed. Futures, FX, ETFs and equities come from Yahoo, delayed up to 15 minutes, and refresh every 15 minutes in market hours when the intraday task is on. Rates, credit indices and macro update once a day.
